title: US6285999B1 — Method for node ranking in a linked database
t0_eligibility_basis: Patent grant predates both experimental T0 dates.
archive_note: Current legal-status labels are not used to backfill historical T0 states. Google public filings contemporaneously stated that the PageRank patent would expire in 2017.

title: Google Inc. Form S-1/A — business, PageRank and intellectual-property disclosures
publisher: Google Inc. / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
t0_eligibility_basis: Filed on the early T0 date. The filing identifies PageRank as an element of Google's ranking technology, states Stanford owns the PageRank patent, states Google's perpetual license and exclusivity through 2011, and reports contemporaneous operating scale and revenues.
archive_note: Enterprise and search-scale metrics are not patent-level value attribution.

title: Google Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2008
publisher: Google Inc. / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission

archive_note: Company revenue is enterprise-level context and must not be inherited by US6285999.
